business_problem: replace complex MySQL-on-Redshift reporting infrastructure with a governed platform that could separate data access by brand, simplify pipelines, and reduce unnecessary data movement.
solution_summary: MarketWise uses Snowflake, Hybrid Tables, and dynamic tables on Snowflake to replace complex mysql-on-redshift reporting infrastructure with a governed platform that could separate data access by brand, simplify pipelines, and reduce unnecessary data movement. Affiliate-specific market intelligence, customer data, reporting data, and other brand datasets are centralized in Snowflake so MarketWise can govern access brand by brand. Dynamic tables create the semantic and reporting layers more simply, while Hybrid Tables remove architectural sprawl and keep transactional and analytical work closer together. Each subsidiary can run its own BI and product-improvement work on its own governed subset of data, and MarketWise can extend the same platform to search and analytics experiences without exporting documents or emails. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data...

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Hybrid Tables
solution_components.role: Keeps transactional and analytical datasets in the same Snowflake environment.

solution_components.name: dynamic tables
solution_components.role: Automates downstream table refreshes and simplifies transformation pipelines.

data_flow: affiliate reporting, customer, and market data flow into Snowflake, Hybrid Tables, and dynamic tables; curated data and model outputs are then served to brand data teams, BI users, and search-style analytics applications.
business_outcome: MarketWise cut MySQL infrastructure costs by 35%, reduced ingestion infrastructure and development work by 50%, improved governance with RBAC, and simplified jobs that had previously been difficult or impossible to run.
metrics: 50% Less infrastructure and development for data ingestion
architecture_clues: Uses role-based access controls to isolate affiliate data by brand.
Dynamic tables simplify reporting pipelines and semantic layers.
Hybrid Tables centralized workloads that previously depended on more complex architectures.
evidence_quotes: Snowflake’s role-based access controls are critical for how we do things
Dynamic Tables makes it a lot easier to get ahead of things
Hybrid Tables just made everything much simpler for us
